name: Foam-Roller Thoracic Extension

instructions.description: Place a foam roller across the upper back and support the head with your hands.
Keep the hips grounded and gently extend over the roller.
Return to neutral without forcing the ribs upward.
Reposition the roller slightly and repeat as comfortable.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

commentsNotes: Support the head and avoid rolling onto the neck or lower back.

variations.variationDescription: Foam-Roller Thoracic Extension — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.
